title: Range Raid
mission: Grab every treasure between the two keys
briefing: Tonight's order: every treasure with a key between the two bounds. Collect them all - but a clever thief never wanders into a wing that cannot hold a wanted key. After the raid the vault shows which wings a pruned search would have skipped.
hints: If a room's key is below the range, nothing in its left wing can be in range.
Collect rooms in sorted order to walk the same path the pruned query takes.
